verdict.rationale: Activepieces supports API keys for authenticating requests and generating tokens per embedded user for MCP-driven automation (docs-2, docs-28, docs-33, docs-35), and agents can be restricted to individual actions/apps rather than full access (docs-30, docs-32), which approximates least-privilege scoping at the agent-tool level. However, there is no documented mechanism for issuing scoped/permissioned API keys themselves (e.g., read-only, resource-limited, or expiring keys) — the API key docs describe a flat per-project key model, not fine-grained credential scoping. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/role-based API key issuance, key expiration/revocation controls, and independent verification that agent-issued tokens enforce least privilege.
